name: AI Chatbot & Live Chat with ChatGPT Support by WebChatAgent
author: WebChatAgent

sections.description:
Add an AI chatbot and live chat to your WordPress site. Answer visitors 24/7, capture leads, book appointments and hand over chats to humans when it matters.

🤖 Description

AI Chatbot & Live Chat for WordPress with ChatGPT and Gemini Support by WebChatAgent lets you add a powerful AI assistant and live chat widget to your WordPress website.

Use advanced features like RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with support for OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini and other top AI models to give your visitors highly relevant answers based on your content. Combine this with human takeover (live chat) so your team can jump in whenever it matters.

You connect your site to your WebChatAgent account, where you manage all AI settings, design, live chat rules, WhatsApp integration, bookings and more. The WordPress plugin focuses on a smooth embed and a live preview in your WP admin.

Key integrations and tools include:

  • Live Chat & Human Takeover – AI handles most questions, humans can take over any conversation in the inbox
  • WhatsApp Business Integration – engage users via your WhatsApp business number
  • API Connector for WooCommerce & More – let customers check their WooCommerce order status, account info or support tickets directly in the chat
  • Zapier Integration – automate workflows and connect to thousands of apps
  • AI Team Wiki – publish an AI-assisted team knowledge base on your subdomain
  • Custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server Support – for advanced, self-hosted or custom AI models

✨ Key Features

  • Generous Free Plan – Start free on WebChatAgent.com and upgrade only when you need more usage or advanced features
  • Hybrid AI Chatbot + Live Chat – Let AI handle routine questions and let humans join any conversation in real time
  • Human Takeover / Agent Inbox – View all conversations in one inbox and take over any chat with a single click
  • Smart Contextual Answers – Uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to answer based on your website content and uploaded documents
  • Multi-LLM Support – Switch between leading cloud models like Google Gemini and OpenAI
  • Custom MCP Server Support – Connect your own Model Context Protocol servers for self-hosted or specialized AI models
  • Tool Integrations – Connect your chatbot with external services and systems to perform actions
    • Lead Management – Automatically collect, qualify and manage potential customer information
    • Feedback Management – Gather and analyze user feedback to improve your service and chatbot
    • Questions Management – Track and categorize all questions asked to your chatbot
  • API Connector for WooCommerce & More – Connect your shop so customers get instant answers
    • WooCommerce Order Status – Customers ask “Where is my order?” and your chatbot checks WooCommerce and answers in seconds
    • WooCommerce Product Info – Let customers ask about product availability, prices or details from your shop
    • Account & Order History – Look up customer accounts, past orders or membership status automatically
    • Support Ticket Updates – Show real-time status of support requests without manual lookup
    • Ready-Made WooCommerce Template – Get started in minutes with our pre-built WooCommerce connector — no coding needed
    • Secure by Design – Customers must verify their identity (e.g. order email) before seeing personal data
  • WhatsApp Business Integration – Let your bot respond to customers on WhatsApp using your business number
  • In-Chat Appointments & Bookings – Allow visitors to book appointments directly inside the chat (with Google Calendar sync on supported plans)
  • Multilingual Support – Automatically responds in the user’s language; human replies can be translated as well
  • WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility – Ensures accessible use for all visitors regardless of disabilities
  • Spam Protection – Prevents chatbot abuse and protects against unexpected usage spikes
  • Complete Customization – Customize appearance, persona, colors, fonts, behavior and more via the WebChatAgent dashboard
  • Live Preview – See your current widget in a live preview iframe inside the WordPress admin
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes
  • Simple Embedding – Easy integration with your WordPress site using a single Chatbot ID

🚀 Installation

  1. Upload the webchatagent folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation or install it directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin area under “Plugins”.
  3. Register or log in at https://webchatagent.com and create your chatbot.
  4. Copy your Chatbot ID from the WebChatAgent dashboard.
  5. In WordPress, navigate to “WebChatAgent” in the admin menu and paste your Chatbot ID.
  6. Enable the chatbot in the plugin settings to display the widget on your site.

All design, AI, live chat, WhatsApp and behavior settings are managed in your WebChatAgent dashboard. The WordPress plugin handles the embed and displays a live preview based on your current configuration.

⚙️ Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need an API key or account to use this plugin?

You need to register at WebChatAgent.com to create a chatbot and get a Chatbot ID. You then enter this ID in the plugin settings to connect your WordPress site to your chatbot. API keys and model settings are managed in your WebChatAgent account.

Is this plugin completely free?

You can start with a free plan on WebChatAgent.com. There are paid plans available if you need higher limits, more pages, more traffic or advanced features like higher message quotas, team features and additional integrations.

Can I customize the appearance of the chat widget?

Yes. You customize the color scheme, avatar, fonts, welcome message, widget position, behavior and persona directly in the WebChatAgent dashboard. The WordPress plugin shows a live preview and uses your current configuration.

Is the chat widget mobile-friendly?

Yes, the chat widget is fully responsive and works well on all devices, including mobile phones and tablets.

Does WebChatAgent support live chat and human takeover?

Yes. WebChatAgent offers a hybrid model: AI answers most questions automatically, and your team can take over any chat at any time via the Agent Inbox. You can reply as a human and then hand control back to the bot if you like.

Does the plugin support WhatsApp Business?

Yes. You can connect your WhatsApp Business number in the WebChatAgent dashboard. Your AI chatbot can then reply to WhatsApp messages, and you can manage those conversations alongside website chats.

How does the AI chatbot understand my website content?

WebChatAgent uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to index and understand your website content and documents. When visitors ask questions, the AI combines this indexed content with a large language model (e.g. ChatGPT or Gemini) to provide accurate, context-aware answers.

Which AI models are supported?

The chatbot supports multiple large language models including Google Gemini and OpenAI. You can choose which model to use in your WebChatAgent settings. Additionally, you can connect custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for self-hosted or specialized AI models.

Does the chatbot support multiple languages?

Yes, the chatbot automatically detects and responds in the user’s language, making it ideal for multilingual websites. Human replies in the inbox can also be auto-translated.

Is the chat widget accessible for people with disabilities?

Yes, the chat widget is designed to meet WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, ensuring it’s usable for all visitors, including those using assistive technologies.

Can the chatbot perform actions beyond just answering questions?

Yes. With Tool Integrations, your chatbot can connect to external services and systems to perform actions such as submitting forms, booking appointments, updating records or querying databases. You configure these tools in your WebChatAgent dashboard.

What is the API Connector and how does it work?

The API Connector lets your chatbot answer questions that require live data from your WooCommerce shop or other business systems. Instead of just answering general questions, your chatbot can look up real information for each customer.

WooCommerce examples:

  • “Where is my order #12345?” – The chatbot checks your WooCommerce shop and tells the customer the current order status
  • “Is the blue T-shirt in size M available?” – Looks up product stock and availability in WooCommerce
  • “Show me my recent orders” – Displays the customer’s order history from your shop

Other systems:

  • Support tickets – Show ticket status from helpdesk systems
  • Account info – Look up balances, memberships or custom data from any system

How to set it up:

  1. Select the WooCommerce template (or another template for your system)
  2. The chatbot asks customers to verify their identity (e.g. their order email)
  3. Once verified, the chatbot can look up their orders, products and personal data

No programming knowledge required — the WooCommerce connector works out of the box.

What analytics and management tools are included?

From your WebChatAgent account, you can access:

  1. Lead Management – Collect, categorize and follow up with leads generated through your chatbot
  2. Feedback Management – Review and analyze user feedback to improve your chatbot and service
  3. Questions Management – View all questions asked to your chatbot, identify common topics and improve your knowledge base
  4. Analytics Dashboard – Track conversations, leads, bookings, human handovers and unanswered questions

How does the spam protection work?

Built-in spam and abuse protection monitor usage patterns and prevent abusive or excessive requests. This helps protect your account from unexpected usage spikes and keeps your costs predictable on higher tiers.

📷 Screenshots

  1. WebChatAgent – AI Chatbot & Live Chat for WordPress settings page in the WordPress admin.
  2. Live chat widget on your website – desktop view.
  3. Mobile view of the chat widget.

📝 Changelog

1.0.3

  • Changed: Admin shows read-only values loaded from public endpoint
  • Changed: Only Chatbot ID and Enable are editable in WP; other settings managed in WebChatAgent dashboard
  • Added: Color swatches for theme and message colors in admin
  • Improved: Preview iframe sets html lang to current WP language

1.0.2

  • Added: Hide branding option in General tab
  • Added: Speech bubble text option in Messages tab
  • Added: Chat button image URL option in Appearance tab
  • Added: Live preview support for new options
  • Added: Documentation for dashboard tools (Leads, Feedback, Questions)
  • Added: Documentation for custom MCP server support
  • Improved: Widget rendering to include new attributes

1.0.0

  • Initial release

🔄 Upgrade Notice

1.0.3

Adds admin read-only values, color swatches and language-aware preview. Also updates documentation for integrations (WhatsApp Business, Zapier, AI Team Wiki, MCP) and clarifies that most settings are managed in the WebChatAgent dashboard.

1.0.2

Initial release of the WebChatAgent – AI Chatbot for WordPress plugin.

🔒 Privacy Policy

WebChatAgent – AI Chatbot for WordPress processes user chat messages to provide AI-powered responses. When visitors interact with the chat widget, their messages are sent to WebChatAgent’s servers for processing. The chat widget also collects basic browser information and IP addresses (in anonymized form) for abuse prevention and geographical customization of services.

Chat conversations are typically stored for up to 30 days to maintain context and provide follow-up support. After this period, conversation data may be anonymized and retained for service improvement purposes.

For privacy inquiries, please contact privacy@webchatagent.com.

We operate in accordance with GDPR.

🌐 External services

This plugin connects to the WebChatAgent service (https://webchatagent.com) to provide chat functionality.

The service loads an external JavaScript file (https://webchatagent.com/widget/web-chat-agent.js) to render the chat widget on your website. This script is required for the widget to function properly.

When using custom fonts, external resources may be loaded from Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com). This means that data may be shared with Google when a visitor views your website with the chat widget enabled.

The service receives the following data when visitors use the chat:

  • Chat messages and queries submitted through the chat widget
  • Basic browser information (user agent, device type)
  • Session information for conversation context preservation
  • IP addresses, stored in anonymized form for abuse prevention and geographical service customization

Data is only sent when a visitor interacts with the chat widget. No data is collected or transmitted until the visitor actively engages with the chat.

Terms of Service: https://webchatagent.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://webchatagent.com/privacy-policy
